James Cormack | Share on Facebook Share on X Add us as a preferred source PSG beat Barcelona in a barnstormer last time out. | David Ramos/UEFA/Getty Images Matchday 4 represents the halfway point in the Champions League league phase, and there’s several heavy-hitters in action in the first round of fixtures. 
--> Matchday 4 represents the halfway point in the Champions League league phase, and there’s several heavy-hitters in action in the first round of fixtures. 
 Only five teams are perfect through three games, including back-to-back winners Paris Saint-Germain, perennial champions Real Madrid, two Premier League teams and ... Real Betis? The Andalusians are enjoying their return to the big time after a two-decade absence, and will continue their campaign on Wednesday against German giants Borussia Dortmund at Signal Iduna Park. 
--> Only five teams are perfect through three games, including back-to-back winners Paris Saint-Germain, perennial champions Real Madrid, two Premier League teams and ... Real Betis? The Andalusians are enjoying their return to the big time after a two-decade absence, and will continue their campaign on Wednesday against German giants Borussia Dortmund at Signal Iduna Park. 
 The maintenance of perfection is one of the several intriguing subplots pervading this set of fixtures, although the majority of eyes will undoubtedly be cast on the events that unfold in Manchester and Madrid. 
--> The maintenance of perfection is one of the several intriguing subplots pervading this set of fixtures, although the majority of eyes will undoubtedly be cast on the events that unfold in Manchester and Madrid.

 Location: Istanbul, Türkiye

 Winning away from home will ultimately decide how far an ambitious Galatasaray can go in this competition, so they would‘ve been greatly encouraged by their 4–2 triumph at Lille on Matchday 3.
--> Winning away from home will ultimately decide how far an ambitious Galatasaray can go in this competition, so they would‘ve been greatly encouraged by their 4–2 triumph at Lille on Matchday 3.
 They’ll undoubtedly be feeling good about themselves when they welcome Stuttgart to Istanbul, with the two teams facing off for the first time in a UEFA competition. 
--> They’ll undoubtedly be feeling good about themselves when they welcome Stuttgart to Istanbul, with the two teams facing off for the first time in a UEFA competition. 
 Galatasaray haven’t beaten German opposition at home in nine attempts, and the visitors head into Tuesday’s fixture in a buoyant mood themselves. They’ve claimed seven points from their opening three matches, including a 1–1 draw with Atlético Madrid last time out, and were impressively victorious in the Bundesliga on Saturday, winning away at Bayer Leverkusen 4–2.
--> Galatasaray haven’t beaten German opposition at home in nine attempts, and the visitors head into Tuesday’s fixture in a buoyant mood themselves. They’ve claimed seven points from their opening three matches, including a 1–1 draw with Atlético Madrid last time out, and were impressively victorious in the Bundesliga on Saturday, winning away at Bayer Leverkusen 4–2.

--> Harry Kane is going to have to carry the load for Bayern Munich in the Spanish capital, given the swathe of injuries the visiting team is dealing with. Der Klassiker was a nightmare occasion for the German champions, who lost Ismael Saibari, Serge Gnabry and Michael Olise to injury. 
 Kane, who paraded his Ballon d’Or to the Allianz Arena before kick-off, produced a rare errant night in front of goal , missing from the penalty spot as Borussia Dortmund scored a late equalizer to earn a 2–2 draw.

--> Barcelona had to bounce back from a difficult week when they welcomed Deportivo Alavés to Camp Nou on Saturday, and Hansi Flick’s team responded by putting six past the out-of-sorts visitors.
